prior_pending_row.reason: H.R. 4553 EH whole passage remains pending. Sections 309-310 restrict DOE awards of at least $10 million to an entity of concern defined in PL 117-167, Division B, section 10114, and funded access by a non-US citizen from Russia or China to a nuclear weapons production facility defined in 50 USC 2501. The latter has a public-area exception and a 30-day advance committee-notification exception. Facility admittance does not establish admission to the United States; entity nationality or control does not automatically establish an immigration rule. The definitions, adopted report/allocations and remaining whole-package predicates need reconstruction. Only EH characters [66400,70400) of 89253 were read in this batch. Research hold only: no inclusion/exclusion, completion credit, inherited Health membership, component stance, enactment or individual legal eligibility is inferred. Further source work is executable; this is not established inaccessible evidence or a new methodology decision.
